notes: s003 takes the discontinuous 'the … man' under rule 102, a Greek article standing to take both the determiner and the supplied noun, leaving νέον bare; s005 is the second attributive article and is emptied, the relativizer being the participle's helper (rule 31).
s011 keeps only 'of him' — the article supplies the pronoun and nothing else, with the case preposition riding on it (rules 21, 32) — and the participle keeps 'that created'.
εἰκόνα is anarthrous, so the supplied 'the' is an ordinary helper on the noun (rule 51).
